raw_segments.text: You don't know how you encourage us, Dmitry Fyodorovich, by your readiness to answer,"
said Nikolay Parfenevich, with an animated air and obvious satisfaction beaming in his
very prominent, short-sighted, light gray eyes from which he had removed his spectacles
And you have made a very just remark about the mutual confidence, without which it is
sometimes positively impossible to get on in cases of such importance if the suspected
party really hopes and desires to defend himself and is in a position to do so.
